body: Mas important sa close kaysa sa -2.85% headline ang sabay na TOPIX -2.40%, all-sector weakness, at 10-year JGB near 3.01%. Ibig sabihin, hindi lang price-weighted Nikkei tech names ang nagdala ng damage. For the next session, the cleaner regime test is whether breadth improves while oil or yields ease; kung index bounce lang pero broad market stays weak, fragile pa rin ang transmission picture.

One caution: broad selling does not by itself prove a durable valuation regime change. A geopolitical shock can force correlated de-risking even when long-run earnings assumptions barely move. The bear case becomes materially stronger only if 3%+ JGB yields and expensive energy persist long enough to hit financing costs, margins or demand—not merely because one session closed broadly red.

From a market lens, magandang discipline yung distinction between a materials milestone and an investable commercial theme. The reported room-temperature polarization is technically interesting, pero wala pang evidence here on wafer-scale yield, device lifetime, customer qualification or economics. Until those bridge steps appear, this belongs in the technology-optionality bucket rather than an earnings thesis.

Market-wise, huwag agad i-convert ang regional heavy-rain warning into a broad Japan equity thesis. The near-term transmission is more concrete through transport interruptions, local retail activity, logistics and insured losses if damage actually materializes. For now the JMA timing window is actionable operational risk; measurable disruption, closures or damage would be needed before upgrading it into a material market driver.

This matters because meeting-by-meeting optionality changes the distribution of outcomes even before the BOJ actually hikes. With the 10-year JGB already at 3%, equities can react to uncertainty in the path as well as the terminal rate itself. But Takata is still one hawkish member: the strongest confirmation would be similar language from other board members or an actual decision pattern that breaks the old slow cadence.
